blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
A supply chain is the path of a product. The product goes from the farm or the factory to the final customer.

A supply chain is a chain of steps. First we produce. Then we move. Then we store. Then we deliver. Every step is important.

At Czarnikow, the supply chain carries sugar, coffee and other products. The chain connects people and places around the world. I am part of the supply chain. We are a global team.

items.q: What is a supply chain?
items.why: "A supply chain is the path of a product."

items.q: Where does the product go?
options: From the customer to the factory
From the store to the farm
From one factory to another factory
From the farm or factory to the final customer
items.why: "The product goes from the farm or the factory to the final customer."

items.q: What does Czarnikow's supply chain carry?
items.why: "the supply chain carries sugar, coffee and other products."

items.q: The text says "Every step is important." This suggests that…
options: Steps are not part of the chain
items.why: Inferência: se todo passo é importante, nenhum pode ser pulado.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: The supply chain connects people and places
The supply chain works alone, without people
Only one country is in the chain
items.why: Inferência: "The chain connects people and places around the world." e "We are a global team."

blocks.instruction: Ouça Maria explicando a cadeia de suprimentos para um colega novo. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hello! Welcome to the team. My name is Maria. I am happy to help you today.

Let me explain the supply chain. It is easy. A supply chain is a path. A product goes from the factory to the customer. That is the chain.

There are four steps. First, we produce the product. Then, we move the product. After that, we store it. Finally, we deliver it to the customer. Four steps. Very simple.

Here at Czarnikow, our main product is sugar. The sugar starts at the factory. It travels many steps. In the end, it is with the customer. Every step is important.

You are part of the chain now. We are a global team. We work together every day. Do not worry — you can do it. I am here to help. Welcome again!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Who is speaking?
items.why: "My name is Maria. I am happy to help you today."

items.q: How many steps are in the chain?
items.why: "There are four steps." — produce, move, store, deliver.

items.q: What is Czarnikow's main product?
items.why: "our main product is sugar."

items.q: How does Maria feel about the new colleague?
items.why: Inferência: "Welcome to the team", "I am here to help" — ela é acolhedora.

items.q: When Maria says "you can do it", she wants the colleague to feel…
items.why: Inferência: ela dá ânimo — "Do not worry — you can do it."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The supply chain moves sugar from the factory to the customer." A supply chain is…
options: the path of a product from start to end
items.why: Supply chain = cadeia de suprimentos: o caminho do produto do início ao fim.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Sugar is our main ___ at Czarnikow."
items.why: Product = produto: aquilo que a empresa vende.

items.q: "The customer is at the end of the chain." A customer is…
options: the person who buys the product
items.why: Customer = cliente: quem compra o produto.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Production starts at the ___."
items.why: Factory = fábrica: o lugar onde a produção começa.

items.q: "Produce, move, store, deliver — each one is a step." A step is…
items.why: Step = etapa: uma parte do processo.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "We roll out the new product next month." To roll out means to…
items.why: Roll out = lançar, começar a usar algo novo.

items.q: "The boss must sign off on the plan." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval.

items.q: "I will follow up with the customer tomorrow." To follow up means to…
items.why: Follow up = dar continuidade, retomar o contato depois.

items.q: "Can you help out with the delivery?" To help out means to…
items.why: Help out = ajudar, dar uma mão.

items.q: "Let's go over the four steps again." To go over means to…
items.why: Go over = revisar, repassar algo.
